change_policy: Never edit this protocol after candidate results are inspected. Any semantic change requires a new immutable version/file committed before the affected experiment.

holdout_policy.TRAIN: Fit parameters, priors, smoothing/backoff and candidate generation only.
holdout_policy.VALIDATION: Select at most one frozen finalist per subsystem/cycle. Never tune from TEST.
holdout_policy.TEST: Confirm or reject only the frozen VALIDATION finalist. TEST may not select an alternative or trigger same-cycle retuning.
holdout_policy.player_leakage_rule: Player-level diagnostics are allowed, but chronological/card/action information unavailable before the evaluated decision must never enter features or labels.
holdout_policy.after_test_consumption: A later scientific cycle requiring a fresh final confirmation must define a new temporal TEST generation before results are inspected.

budgets.pairing: Cards, seats, stacks, opponent profiles and random streams are paired across compared Hero policies until trajectories legitimately diverge.
budgets.reduced_budget_runs: Allowed for debugging only; they are never promotion-eligible and must be labelled PILOT or DEBUG.

statistics.multiple_candidate_rule: VALIDATION may rank candidates; TEST is run on one frozen finalist only.

preflop.promotion_rule: paired candidate-minus-incumbent 95% CI upper bound <= 0 on VALIDATION; TEST may only confirm a frozen promoted finalist when the cycle contract requires final confirmation

postflop.promotion_rule: paired candidate-minus-incumbent 95% CI upper bound <= 0 on VALIDATION; final TEST use follows the same frozen-finalist rule

hero_strategy.accounting: Net chips from blind posting through final settlement, including folds before flop, uncontested pots, all-ins, side pots and population rake semantics.

environment_sensitivity.rule: A promotion claim must not rely on a single Model B parameterization; report the same paired strategy metrics under the nominal environment and at least two predeclared plausible sensitivity variants.

publication.live_deployment_verification: Post-promotion verification remains separate and is tracked by issue #45/#113.

interpretation_limits: A historical hand result is not an observed counterfactual EV for another action.
A simulated BB/100 is an environment-conditional benchmark, not a guaranteed real-world win rate.
A favorable point estimate without the required confidence bound does not authorize promotion.
Passing Model A/B prediction gates does not by itself establish Hero strategy profitability.
Passing strategy gates under one population does not generalize to another population.
